summary: Enhance your communication skills with our Advanced Communication Skills Training Course. Learn effective techniques to connect and engage with others.
lede: Advanced workplace communication helps professionals shape clear messages for important conversations and decisions. For managers and other professionals who brief leaders, negotiate, or handle sensitive discussions, the course builds skills in adapting messages to audiences, simplifying complex information, and persuading with credibility. It also covers listening and managing emotions to turn disagreements toward collaboration.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly engage in high-stakes communication:
